senses.definition_vi: một cây nhỏ có lá màu xanh đậm với mùi thơm ngọt được sử dụng trong nấu ăn

senses.definition: the leaves of the bay tree, used in cooking as a herb
senses.definition_vi: lá của cây nguyệt quế, được sử dụng trong nấu ăn như một loại thảo mộc

senses.definition: when an animal that is being hunted is at bay, it must turn and face the dogs and hunters because it is impossible to escape from them
senses.definition_vi: khi một con vật bị săn đuổi đang bị dồn vào đường cùng, nó phải quay lại đối mặt với chó và thợ săn vì không thể thoát khỏi chúng

senses.definition: to prevent an enemy from coming close or a problem from having a bad effect

examples.x: I'm trying to keep my creditors at bay.
Charlotte bit her lip to hold the tears at bay.

senses.definition_vi: ngăn kẻ thù đến gần hoặc ngăn chặn một vấn đề có ảnh hưởng xấu

senses.definition: used when you are naming people or things, describing them or giving more information about them

examples.x: Today is Monday.
‘Who is that?’ ‘It's my brother.’
She's a great artist.
Susan is a doctor.
He wants to be (= become) a pilot when he grows up.
It's beautiful!
Life is unfair.
He is ten years old.
‘How are you?’ ‘I'm very well, thanks.’
Be quick!
The fact is (that) we don’t have enough money.
The problem is getting it all done in the time available.
The problem is to get it all done in the time available.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang gọi tên người hoặc sự vật, mô tả chúng hoặc cung cấp thêm thông tin về chúng

senses.definition: used when you are describing a situation or saying what you think about it

examples.x: It was really hot in the sauna.
It's strange how she never comes to see us any more.
He thinks it's clever to make fun of people.
It would be a shame if you lost it.
It's going to be a great match.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang mô tả một tình huống hoặc nói lên suy nghĩ của bạn về nó

senses.definition: to exist; to be present

examples.x: Is there a God?
Once upon a time there was a princess…
I tried phoning but there was no answer.
There's a bank down the road.
Was there a pool at the hotel?

senses.definition_vi: tồn tại; có mặt

senses.definition: to be located; to be in a place

examples.x: The town is three miles away.
If you're looking for your file, it's on the table.
Mary's upstairs.

senses.definition_vi: được định vị; ở một nơi

senses.definition: used to say where somebody was born or where their home is

examples.x: She's from Italy.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói nơi ai đó sinh ra hoặc nơi nhà của họ

senses.definition: to happen at a time or in a place

examples.x: The party is on Friday evening.
The meetings are always in the main conference room.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra vào một thời điểm hoặc ở một địa điểm

senses.definition: to remain in a place

examples.x: She has been in her room for hours.
They're here till Christmas.

senses.definition_vi: ở lại một nơi

senses.definition: to attend an event; to be present in a place

examples.x: I'll be at the party.
He'll be here soon (= will arrive soon).

senses.definition_vi: tham dự một sự kiện; có mặt ở một địa điểm

senses.definition: used to talk about time

examples.x: It's two thirty.
It was late at night when we finally arrived.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói về thời gian

senses.definition: to cost

examples.x: ‘How much is that dress?’ ‘Eighty dollars.’

senses.definition_vi: có giá

senses.definition: to be equal to

examples.x: Three and three is six.
How much is a thousand pounds in euros?
Let x be the sum of a and b.
London is not England (= do not think that all of England is like London).

senses.definition_vi: bằng với

senses.definition: to visit or call

examples.x: I've never been to Spain.
He had been abroad many times.
Has the postman been yet?

senses.definition_vi: thăm viếng hoặc ghé qua

senses.definition: used to say what something is made of

examples.x: Is your jacket real leather?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói cái gì đó được làm từ gì

senses.definition: used to say who something belongs to or who it is intended for

examples.x: The money's not yours, it's John's.
This package is for you.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói cái gì đó thuộc về ai hoặc dành cho ai

senses.definition: used to say how important something is to somebody

examples.x: Money isn't everything (= it is not the only important thing).
A thousand dollars is nothing to somebody as rich as he is.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói cái gì đó quan trọng với ai như thế nào

senses.definition: as somebody/something used to be called

examples.x: Jill Davis that was (= before her marriage)
the Soviet Union, as was

senses.definition_vi: như ai đó/cái gì đó từng được gọi

senses.definition: the most important part; all that matters

examples.x: Her career is the be-all and end-all of her existence.

senses.definition_vi: phần quan trọng nhất; tất cả những gì quan trọng

senses.definition: used to show that you are surprised and annoyed by something that somebody has done

examples.x: Someone's been and parked in front of the entrance!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn ngạc nhiên và bực mình bởi điều gì đó mà ai đó đã làm

senses.definition: used to say that somebody/something stopped somebody/something from happening

examples.x: If it weren't for you, I wouldn't be alive today.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng ai đó/cái gì đó đã ngăn cản ai đó/cái gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: used to show that you accept that something negative cannot be changed

examples.x: I never imagined that our company share prices would fall so low, but it is what it is.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn chấp nhận rằng điều tiêu cực không thể thay đổi

senses.definition: to leave somebody/something alone without bothering them/it

examples.x: Leave her be, she obviously doesn't want to talk about it.
Let the poor dog be (= don't annoy it).

senses.definition_vi: để ai đó/cái gì đó một mình mà không làm phiền họ/nó

senses.definition: future

examples.x: his bride-to-be
mothers-to-be (= pregnant women)

senses.definition_vi: tương lai

senses.definition: used with a present participle to form progressive tenses

examples.x: I am studying Chinese.
I'll be seeing him soon.
What have you been doing this week?
I'm always being criticized.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng với hiện tại phân từ để tạo thành thì tiếp diễn

senses.definition: used to make question tags (= short questions added to the end of statements)

examples.x: You're not hungry, are you?
Ben's coming, isn't he?
The old theatre was pulled down, wasn't it?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để tạo câu hỏi đuôi (= các câu hỏi ngắn được thêm vào cuối câu trần thuật)

senses.definition: used with a past participle to form the passive

examples.x: He was killed in the war.
Where were they made?
The house was still being built.
You will be told what to do.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng với quá khứ phân từ để tạo thành thể bị động

senses.definition: used to avoid repeating the full form of a verb in the passive or a progressive tense

examples.x: Karen wasn't beaten in any of her games, but all the others were.
‘Are you coming with us?’ ‘No, I'm not.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để tránh lặp lại dạng đầy đủ của động từ ở thể bị động hoặc thì tiếp diễn

senses.definition: used to say what must or should be done

examples.x: I am to call them once I reach the airport.
You are to report this to the police.
What is to be done about this problem?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói những gì phải hoặc nên được làm

senses.definition: used to say what is arranged to happen

examples.x: They are to be married in June.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói những gì được sắp xếp để xảy ra

senses.definition: used to say what happened later

examples.x: He was to regret that decision for the rest of his life (= he did regret it).

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói những gì đã xảy ra sau đó

senses.definition: used to say what could not or did not happen

examples.x: Anna was nowhere to be found (= we could not find her anywhere).
He was never to see his wife again (= although he did not know it would be so at the time, he did not see her again).
She wanted to write a successful novel, but it was not to be (= it turned out never to happen).

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói những gì không thể hoặc đã không xảy ra

senses.definition: used to express a condition

examples.x: If we were to offer you more money, would you stay?
Were we to offer you more money, would you stay?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để diễn tả một điều kiện

senses.definition: an area of sand or small stones (called shingle), next to the sea or a lake

examples.x: tourists sunbathing on the beach
He decided to go to the beach for a swim.
She often spent summer days at the beach.
a sandy beach
a pebble/shingle beach
a beach bar
We rented an airy apartment at a beach resort.

senses.definition_vi: một khu vực cát hoặc đá nhỏ (gọi là sỏi), liền kề với biển hoặc hồ

senses.definition: a line of light, electromagnetic waves or particles

examples.x: narrow beams of light/sunlight
the beam of a torch/flashlight
a laser/electron beam
The car's headlights were on full beam (= shining as brightly as possible and not directed downwards).

senses.definition_vi: một luồng ánh sáng, sóng điện từ hoặc hạt

senses.definition: a long piece of wood, metal, etc. used to support weight, especially as part of the roof in a building

examples.x: The cottage had exposed oak beams.

senses.definition_vi: một thanh gỗ, kim loại dài, v.v. được dùng để chịu trọng lượng, đặc biệt là một phần của mái nhà trong một tòa nhà

senses.definition: a wooden bar that is used in the sport of gymnastics for people to move and balance on

examples.x: The gymnast performed a somersault on the beam.

senses.definition_vi: một thanh gỗ được sử dụng trong môn thể dục dụng cụ để mọi người di chuyển và giữ thăng bằng

senses.definition: a wide and happy smile

examples.x: a beam of satisfaction

senses.definition_vi: một nụ cười rộng và hạnh phúc

senses.definition: not correct; wrong

examples.x: Your calculation is way off beam.

senses.definition_vi: không đúng; sai

senses.definition: a seed, or pod containing seeds, of a climbing plant, eaten as a vegetable. There are several types of bean and the plants that they grow on are also called beans.

examples.x: green beans
runner beans
beans (= baked beans) on toast
a can/tin of beans
She grows her own broad beans.

senses.definition_vi: một hạt, hoặc một quả chứa hạt, của một cây leo, được ăn như một loại rau. Có nhiều loại đậu và cây mà chúng mọc trên đó cũng được gọi là đậu.

senses.definition: a seed from a coffee plant, or some other plants

examples.x: cocoa/coffee beans

senses.definition_vi: một hạt từ cây cà phê, hoặc một số cây khác

senses.definition: having a lot of energy
senses.definition_vi: có nhiều năng lượng

senses.definition: something that is not worth much
senses.definition_vi: thứ gì đó không đáng giá nhiều

senses.definition: to have no money
senses.definition_vi: không có tiền

senses.definition: to know nothing about a subject

examples.x: I don’t know beans about making movies.

senses.definition_vi: không biết gì về một chủ đề

senses.definition: to tell somebody something that should be kept secret or private

examples.x: We don't want to spill the beans yet.
She made the mistake of spilling the tea on her sister's love life.

senses.definition_vi: nói cho ai đó biết điều gì đó nên được giữ bí mật hoặc riêng tư

senses.definition: a heavy wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws (= pointed parts on the ends of its feet). There are many types of bear.

examples.x: a black bear
A little bear cub ran right across the road in front of us.

senses.definition_vi: một loài động vật hoang dã nặng nề với bộ lông dày và móng vuốt sắc nhọn (= bộ phận nhọn ở đầu chân). Có nhiều loại gấu.

senses.definition: a person who sells shares in a company, etc., hoping to buy them back later at a lower price
senses.definition_vi: một người bán cổ phiếu trong một công ty, v.v., với hy vọng mua lại chúng sau đó với giá thấp hơn

senses.definition: in a bad mood; in an angry way

examples.x: I should keep out of his way. He’s like a bear with a sore head this morning.

senses.definition_vi: tâm trạng tồi tệ; một cách giận dữ

senses.definition: to be able to accept and deal with something unpleasant

examples.x: The pain was almost more than he could bear.
She bore it all with her usual patience.
She couldn't bear the thought of losing him.
I can't bear having cats in the house.
He can't bear being laughed at.
He can't bear to be laughed at.
I can hardly bear to think about it.
How can you bear to eat that stuff?
I can't bear you doing that.

senses.definition_vi: có thể chấp nhận và đối phó với điều gì đó khó chịu

senses.definition: to take responsibility for something

examples.x: She bore the responsibility for most of the changes.
Do parents have to bear the whole cost of tuition fees?
In the end it's consumers who bear the burden of higher prices.
You shouldn't have to bear the blame for other people's mistakes.
You must bear at least some responsibility for what has happened.

senses.definition_vi: chịu trách nhiệm về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to support the weight of somebody/something

examples.x: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.

senses.definition_vi: chịu trọng lượng của ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to show something; to carry something so that it can be seen

examples.x: The document bore her signature.
He was badly wounded in the war and still bears the scars.
She bears little resemblance to (= is not much like) her mother.
The title of the essay bore little relation to (= was not much connected with) the contents.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện điều gì đó; mang theo điều gì đó để có thể nhìn thấy

senses.definition: to not be suitable for something

examples.x: Her later work does not bear comparison with her earlier novels (= because it is not nearly as good).
The plan won't bear close inspection (= it will be found to be unacceptable when carefully examined).
The joke doesn't bear repeating (= because it is not funny or may offend people).
His sufferings don't bear thinking about (= because they are so terrible).

senses.definition_vi: không phù hợp với cái gì đó

senses.definition: to have a feeling, especially a negative feeling

examples.x: He bears no resentment towards them.
He's borne a grudge against me ever since that day.
He's borne me a grudge ever since that day.
She bore him no ill will.

senses.definition_vi: có một cảm giác, đặc biệt là cảm giác tiêu cực

senses.definition: to have a particular name

examples.x: a family that bore an ancient and honoured name

senses.definition_vi: có một cái tên cụ thể

senses.definition: to carry somebody/something, especially while moving

examples.x: three kings bearing gifts

senses.definition_vi: mang theo ai đó/cái gì đó, đặc biệt là khi di chuyển

senses.definition: to move, behave or act in a particular way

examples.x: He bears himself (= stands, walks, etc.) proudly, like a soldier.
She bore herself with dignity throughout the funeral.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển, cư xử hoặc hành động theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition: to give birth to a child

examples.x: She was not able to bear children.
She had borne him six sons.

senses.definition_vi: sinh một đứa trẻ

senses.definition: to produce flowers or fruit

examples.x: These trees take a long time to bear fruit.

senses.definition_vi: ra hoa hoặc kết trái

senses.definition: to go or turn in the direction mentioned

examples.x: When you get to the fork in the road, bear right.

senses.definition_vi: đi hoặc rẽ theo hướng được đề cập

senses.definition: to be a soldier; to fight
senses.definition_vi: là một người lính; chiến đấu

senses.definition: to have a successful result
senses.definition_vi: mang lại một kết quả thành công

senses.definition: to be a cause of difficulty or worry to somebody

examples.x: Taxation bears heavily on us all.
The burden of the tax bore most heavily on the poor.

senses.definition_vi: là nguyên nhân gây ra khó khăn hoặc lo lắng cho ai đó

senses.definition: to remember somebody/something; to remember or consider that…

examples.x: You don't have to do anything about it now… just bear it in mind.

senses.definition_vi: nhớ ai đó/cái gì đó; nhớ hoặc xem xét rằng...

senses.definition: to receive the main force of something unpleasant

examples.x: Schools will bear the brunt of cuts in government spending.

senses.definition_vi: nhận lực chính của một điều gì đó khó chịu

senses.definition: to provide evidence of the truth of something

examples.x: The crowd of mourners at his funeral bore witness to the great affection in which he was held.
The ancient temples bear silent witness to the passing dynasties.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp bằng chứng về sự thật của một điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be realized by somebody, especially after a period of time

examples.x: It was gradually borne in on us that defeat was inevitable.

senses.definition_vi: được ai đó nhận ra, đặc biệt là sau một thời gian

senses.definition: to use energy, pressure, influence, etc. to try to achieve something or make somebody do something

examples.x: We must bring all our energies to bear upon the task.
Pressure was brought to bear on us to finish the work on time.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng năng lượng, áp lực, ảnh hưởng, v.v. để cố gắng đạt được điều gì đó hoặc khiến ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to accept pain or bad luck without complaining

examples.x: There's nothing we can do about it. We'll just have to grin and bear it.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận nỗi đau hoặc vận rủi mà không phàn nàn

senses.definition: to have a difficult problem that makes you worried or unhappy but that you have to deal with

examples.x: We all have our crosses to bear.

senses.definition_vi: có một vấn đề khó khăn khiến bạn lo lắng hoặc không vui nhưng bạn phải đối mặt

senses.definition: an animal, especially one that is large or dangerous, or one that is unusual

examples.x: wild/savage/ferocious beasts
mythical beasts such as unicorns and dragons

senses.definition_vi: một loài động vật, đặc biệt là loài lớn hoặc nguy hiểm, hoặc loài kỳ lạ

senses.definition: a person who is cruel and whose behaviour shows a lack of control

examples.x: The beast in her wanted to destroy his house.

senses.definition_vi: một người tàn nhẫn và có hành vi thiếu kiểm soát

senses.definition: an unpleasant person or thing

examples.x: The maths exam was a real beast.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc một thứ khó chịu

senses.definition: a thing of a particular kind

examples.x: His new guitar is a very expensive beast.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ thuộc một loại cụ thể

senses.definition: a single hit to something, such as a drum, or a movement of something, such as your heart; the sound that this makes

examples.x: several loud beats on the drum
a heart rate of 80 beats per minute

senses.definition_vi: một lần đánh vào cái gì đó, như trống, hoặc một chuyển động của cái gì đó, như tim; âm thanh mà nó tạo ra

senses.definition: a series of regular hits to something, such as a drum; the sound that this makes

examples.x: the steady beat of the drums
He could feel the beat of his heart.

senses.definition_vi: một loạt các lần đánh đều đặn vào cái gì đó, như trống; âm thanh mà nó tạo ra

senses.definition: the main rhythm, or a unit of rhythm, in a piece of music, a poem, etc.

examples.x: This type of music has a strong beat to it.
The piece has four beats to the bar.
Pause for two beats and then repeat the chorus.
The track opens with a pounding drum beat.
She tapped her fingers to the beat of the music.

senses.definition_vi: nhịp chính, hoặc một đơn vị nhịp, trong một bản nhạc, một bài thơ, v.v.

senses.definition: the area that a police officer walks around regularly and which they are responsible for

examples.x: More police officers out on the beat may help to cut crime.

senses.definition_vi: khu vực mà một cảnh sát đi bộ thường xuyên và chịu trách nhiệm

senses.definition: used to say that somebody has a sudden feeling of fear, excitement, etc.

examples.x: My heart missed a beat when I saw who it was.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng ai đó có cảm giác sợ hãi, phấn khích, v.v. đột ngột

senses.definition: to behave in a different way from other people; to have different attitudes or ideas

examples.x: She was a gifted and original artist who marched to a different drummer.

senses.definition_vi: hành xử khác với người khác; có thái độ hoặc ý tưởng khác biệt

senses.definition: to walk around the area that they are responsible for

examples.x: We have two officers walking the beat after midnight.

senses.definition_vi: đi bộ quanh khu vực mà họ chịu trách nhiệm

senses.definition: to defeat somebody in a game or competition

examples.x: He beat me at chess.
She was narrowly beaten by the German in the final.
I beat her by just three points.
Their recent wins have proved they're still the ones to beat (= the most difficult team to beat).

senses.definition_vi: đánh bại ai đó trong một trò chơi hoặc cuộc thi

senses.definition: to do or be better than something

examples.x: Nothing beats home cooking.
You can't beat Italian shoes.
For a break in the sun, Thailand is hard to beat.
They want to beat the speed record (= go faster than anyone before).
This is his latest attempt to beat the world record.

senses.definition_vi: làm tốt hơn hoặc vượt qua cái gì đó

senses.definition: to get control of something

examples.x: The government's main aim is to beat inflation.

senses.definition_vi: kiểm soát cái gì đó

senses.definition: to be too difficult for somebody

examples.x: It is a problem that beats even the experts.
It beats me (= I don't know) why he did it.
What beats me (= what I don't understand) is how it was done so quickly.
‘Where's she gone?’ ‘Beats me.’

senses.definition_vi: quá khó đối với ai đó

senses.definition: to avoid something

examples.x: If we go early we should beat the traffic.
We were up and off early to beat the heat.

senses.definition_vi: tránh một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to hit a person hard and many times in order to hurt them

examples.x: At that time children were regularly beaten for quite minor offences (= as a punishment).
A man was found beaten to death.
