senses.definition: used to ask somebody to repeat what they have just said because you did not hear

examples.x: ‘It's on Duke Street.’ ‘I beg your pardon.’ ‘Duke Street.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để yêu cầu ai đó lặp lại những gì họ vừa nói vì bạn đã không nghe thấy

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that you are offended by what they have just said or by the way that they have said it

examples.x: ‘Just go away.’ ‘I beg your pardon!’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói với ai đó rằng bạn bị xúc phạm bởi những gì họ vừa nói hoặc bởi cách họ nói

senses.definition: used to say politely that you do not agree with something that has just been said

examples.x: ‘At least she is good at her job.’ ‘Oh, I beg to differ.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để lịch sự nói rằng bạn không đồng ý với điều vừa được nói

senses.definition: to start doing something; to do the first part of something

examples.x: Shall I begin?
Let's begin at page 9.
I'd like to begin with a simple question.
She began by thanking us all for coming.
We began work on the project in May.
I began (= started reading) this novel last month and I still haven't finished it.
He always begins his lessons with a warm-up exercise.
I began piano lessons at the age of six.
She began her speech by praising her opponent.
He began his political career as a student (= when he was a student).
I began to feel dizzy.
Leaves are just beginning to appear.
We have already begun to address the problem.
I was beginning to think you'd never come.
Everyone began talking at once.
We began working on the project in May.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu làm điều gì đó; làm phần đầu của điều gì đó

senses.definition: to start to happen or exist, especially from a particular time

examples.x: When does the concert begin?
Work on the new bridge is due to begin in September.
The lecture begins at 8pm.
The evening began well.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu xảy ra hoặc tồn tại, đặc biệt là từ một thời điểm nhất định

senses.definition: to have something as the first part or the point where something starts

examples.x: Where does Europe end and Asia begin?
Use ‘an’ before words beginning with a vowel.
‘I'm thinking of a country in Asia.’ ‘What does it begin with (= what is the first letter)?’
Each chapter begins with a quotation.
The path begins at Livingston village.
The story begins on the island of Corfu.

senses.definition_vi: có điều gì đó làm phần đầu hoặc điểm khởi đầu của điều gì đó

senses.definition: to start or make something start for the first time

examples.x: The school began in 1920, with only ten pupils.
He began a new magazine on post-war architecture.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu hoặc làm cho điều gì đó bắt đầu lần đầu tiên

senses.definition: to be something first, before becoming something else

examples.x: He began as an actor, before starting to direct films.
What began as a minor scuffle turned into a full-scale riot.

senses.definition_vi: là điều gì đó trước tiên, trước khi trở thành điều gì khác

senses.definition: to start speaking

examples.x: ‘Ladies and gentlemen,’ he began, ‘welcome to the Town Hall.’

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu nói

senses.definition: to make no attempt to do something or have no chance of doing something

examples.x: I can't begin to thank you enough.
He didn't even begin to understand my problem.

senses.definition_vi: không cố gắng làm điều gì đó hoặc không có cơ hội làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: you should help and care for your own family, etc. before you start helping other people
senses.definition_vi: bạn nên giúp đỡ và chăm sóc gia đình của mình, v.v. trước khi bạn bắt đầu giúp đỡ người khác

senses.definition: at first

examples.x: I found it tiring to begin with but I soon got used to it.
We'll go slowly to begin with.

senses.definition_vi: ban đầu

senses.definition: used to introduce the first point you want to make

examples.x: ‘What was it you didn't like?’ ‘Well, to begin with, our room was far too small.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để đưa ra điểm đầu tiên bạn muốn nói

senses.definition: the time when something starts; the first part of an event, a story, etc.

examples.x: A story has to have a beginning, middle, and end.
We missed the beginning of the movie.
She's been working there since the beginning of last summer.
The birth of their first child marked the beginning of a new era in their life together.
We're going to Japan at the beginning of July.
The animals were weighed at the beginning and end of the experiment.
At the beginning of 1836, the work was finished.
Let's start again from the beginning.
I've read the whole book from beginning to end and still can't understand it.
Our position was quite clear from the very beginning.

senses.definition_vi: thời điểm khi điều gì đó bắt đầu; phần đầu của một sự kiện, một câu chuyện, v.v.

senses.definition: the first or early ideas, signs or stages of something

examples.x: Did democracy have its beginnings in ancient Greece?
The company has grown from humble beginnings.

senses.definition_vi: những ý tưởng, dấu hiệu hoặc giai đoạn đầu tiên của điều gì đó

senses.definition: the first sign of something ending

examples.x: The scandal was the beginning of the end of his career as a politician.

senses.definition_vi: dấu hiệu đầu tiên của điều gì đó kết thúc

senses.definition: in order to help somebody

examples.x: He began a petition in behalf of the farmers.

senses.definition_vi: để giúp đỡ ai đó

senses.definition: as the representative of somebody or instead of them

examples.x: On behalf of the department I would like to thank you all.
Her son collected the Nobel Peace Prize on her behalf.

senses.definition_vi: như người đại diện của ai đó hoặc thay cho họ

senses.definition: in order to help somebody

examples.x: They campaigned on behalf of asylum seekers.

senses.definition_vi: để giúp đỡ ai đó

senses.definition: because of somebody; for somebody

examples.x: Don't worry on my behalf.

senses.definition_vi: vì ai đó; vì ai đó

senses.definition: to do things in a particular way

examples.x: The doctor behaved very unprofessionally.
They behaved very badly towards their guests.
He behaved like a true gentleman.
They behave differently when you're not around.
He had always behaved in a friendly manner towards us.
I expect you to behave in a certain way.
She behaved with great dignity.
He behaved as if/though nothing had happened.

senses.definition_vi: hành động theo một cách nhất định

senses.definition: to do things in a way that people think is correct or polite

examples.x: Will you kids just behave!
She doesn't know how to behave in public.
The children always behave for their father.
I want you to behave yourselves while I'm away.

senses.definition_vi: hành động theo cách mà mọi người cho là đúng hoặc lịch sự

senses.definition: behaving in the way mentioned

examples.x: well-/badly behaved children

senses.definition_vi: hành xử theo cách được đề cập

senses.definition: to naturally react, move, etc. in a particular way

examples.x: a study of how metals behave under pressure

senses.definition_vi: phản ứng, di chuyển, v.v. một cách tự nhiên theo một cách nhất định

senses.definition: to behave in a very confident way that annoys other people, for example by telling them what to do

examples.x: She was acting as if she owned the place.

senses.definition_vi: hành xử một cách rất tự tin và làm phiền người khác, ví dụ bằng cách nói cho họ biết phải làm gì

senses.definition: the way that somebody behaves, especially towards other people

examples.x: good/bad behaviour
social/sexual/criminal behaviour
a plan to tackle antisocial behaviour
His behaviour towards me was becoming more and more hostile.
She began to exhibit violent behaviour.
I noticed a change in his behaviour.
It is hard to change old patterns of behaviour.

senses.definition_vi: cách cư xử của ai đó, đặc biệt là đối với người khác

senses.definition: the way a person, an animal, a plant, a chemical, etc. behaves or functions in a particular situation

examples.x: studying human and animal behaviour
the behaviour of dolphins/chromosomes
Quantum theory describes the behaviour of subatomic particles.
Animals in zoos often display disturbed behaviour.
Several factors influence dietary behaviour.
Changing consumer behaviour will take some time.
Activity near the birds' nest is bound to affect their behaviour.
to study learned behaviours
the effects of social media on attitudes and behaviours
aggressive/negative/unacceptable/violent behaviours
They encourage patients to adopt healthy behaviours.

senses.definition_vi: cách một người, động vật, thực vật, hóa chất, v.v. hành xử hoặc hoạt động trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: to behave in the most polite way you can
senses.definition_vi: cư xử một cách lịch sự nhất có thể

senses.definition: at or towards the back of somebody/something; further back

examples.x: She rode off down the road with the dog running behind.
The others are a long way behind.
A hand came from behind and tapped him on the shoulder.
I had fallen so far behind that it seemed pointless trying to catch up.

senses.definition_vi: ở phía sau hoặc hướng về phía sau của ai đó/thứ gì đó; xa hơn về phía sau

senses.definition: in the place where somebody/something is or was

examples.x: I was told to stay behind after school (= remain in school).
This bag was left behind after the class.

senses.definition_vi: ở nơi mà ai đó/thứ gì đó đang ở hoặc đã từng ở

senses.definition: late in paying money or completing work

examples.x: She's fallen behind with the payments.
He was terribly behind in his work.

senses.definition_vi: chậm trễ trong việc thanh toán tiền hoặc hoàn thành công việc

senses.definition: at or towards the back of somebody/something, and often hidden by it or them

examples.x: Who's the girl standing behind Jan?
Stay close behind me.
a small street behind the station
She glanced behind her.
Don't forget to lock the door behind you (= when you leave).
The sun disappeared behind the clouds.

senses.definition_vi: ở phía sau hoặc hướng về phía sau của ai đó/thứ gì đó, và thường bị nó che khuất

senses.definition: making less progress than somebody/something

examples.x: He's behind the rest of the class in reading.
We're behind schedule (= late).

senses.definition_vi: tiến bộ chậm hơn ai đó/thứ gì đó

senses.definition: giving support to or approval of somebody/something

examples.x: She knew that, whatever she decided, her family was right behind her.

senses.definition_vi: ủng hộ hoặc chấp thuận ai đó/thứ gì đó

senses.definition: responsible for starting or developing something

examples.x: What's behind that happy smile (= what is causing it)?
He was the man behind the plan to build a new hospital.

senses.definition_vi: chịu trách nhiệm bắt đầu hoặc phát triển điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that something is in somebody’s past

examples.x: The accident is behind you now, so try to forget it.
She has ten years' useful experience behind her.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó đã ở trong quá khứ của ai đó

senses.definition: existence

examples.x: The Irish Free State came into being in 1922.
A new era was brought into being by the war.

senses.definition_vi: sự tồn tại

senses.definition: a living creature

examples.x: human beings
a strange being from another planet
No living being deserves to be treated this way.

senses.definition_vi: một sinh vật sống

senses.definition: your mind and all of your feelings

examples.x: I hated him with my whole being.

senses.definition_vi: tâm trí và tất cả cảm xúc của bạn

senses.definition: a strong feeling that something/somebody exists or is true; confidence that something/somebody is good or right

examples.x: I admire his passionate belief in what he is doing.
belief in God/democracy
The incident has shaken my belief (= made me have less confidence) in the police.
They share a belief that there is life after death.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác mạnh mẽ rằng điều gì đó/ai đó tồn tại hoặc là sự thật; sự tin tưởng rằng điều gì đó/ai đó là tốt hoặc đúng

senses.definition: an opinion about something; something that you think is true

examples.x: There is a general belief that things will soon get better.
There is a widespread belief that multinationals have too much power.
a widely/commonly held belief
She acted in the belief that she was doing good.
I took the job in the mistaken belief that I would be able to stay in London.
Contrary to popular belief (= in spite of what people may think), he was not responsible for the tragedy.

senses.definition_vi: một ý kiến về điều gì đó; điều gì đó bạn nghĩ là đúng

senses.definition: something that you believe, especially as part of your religion

examples.x: religious/political beliefs
A society should be judged on its beliefs and values.
Some people hold beliefs about the world that are not supported by science.

senses.definition_vi: điều mà bạn tin, đặc biệt là như một phần của tôn giáo của bạn

senses.definition: to be too extreme, horrible, etc. to believe/describe

examples.x: It beggars belief how things could have got this bad.

senses.definition_vi: quá cực đoan, khủng khiếp, v.v. đến mức không thể tin/mô tả được

senses.definition: (in a way that is) too great, difficult, etc. to be believed

examples.x: Dissatisfaction with the government has grown beyond belief.
icy air that was cold beyond belief
It is beyond belief that anyone could commit such a crime.

senses.definition_vi: (theo cách) quá lớn, khó khăn, v.v. đến mức không thể tin được

senses.definition: as far as you know

examples.x: He never made a will, to the best of my knowledge.

senses.definition_vi: trong phạm vi hiểu biết của bạn

senses.definition: to feel certain that something is true or that somebody is telling you the truth

examples.x: I don't believe you!
The man claimed to be a social worker and she believed him.
Do you really believe her?
Believe me, she's not right for you.
I believed their lies for years.
I find that hard to believe.
Don't believe a word of it (= don't believe any part of what somebody is saying).
People used to believe (that) the earth was flat.
He refused to believe (that) his son was involved in drugs.
I do believe you’re right (= I think something is true, even though it is surprising).

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy chắc chắn rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc ai đó đang nói sự thật với bạn

senses.definition: to think that something is true or possible, although you are not completely certain

examples.x: ‘Where does she come from?’ ‘Spain, I believe.’
‘Does he still work there?’ ‘I believe so/not.’
Police believe (that) the man may be armed.
Experts believe that the diamond is the only one of its kind.
l firmly believe that they are still alive.
There is no reason to believe he is dangerous.
It is believed that the couple have left the country.
It is widely believed that he was forced to resign.
Few people believe the claim that the cost of living has not risen since last year.

examples.cf: be believed to be, have, etc. something
examples.x: The vases are believed to be worth over $20 000 each.
Three sailors are missing, believed drowned.

senses.definition_vi: nghĩ rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc có thể, mặc dù bạn không hoàn toàn chắc chắn

senses.definition: to have the opinion that something is right or true

examples.x: The party believes (that) education is the most important issue facing the government.
She believes that killing animals for food or fur is completely immoral.
I strongly believe that competition is a good thing.
She truly believes that love can change the world.

senses.definition_vi: có quan điểm rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc đúng

senses.definition: used to say that you are surprised or annoyed at something

examples.x: She couldn’t believe (that) it was all happening again.
I don't believe I'm doing this!
I can't believe how much better I feel.
I couldn't believe what I was hearing.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn ngạc nhiên hoặc khó chịu về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have a religious faith

examples.x: The god appears only to those who believe.

senses.definition_vi: có đức tin tôn giáo

senses.definition: used to introduce information that is true but that may surprise people

examples.x: Believe it or not, he asked me to marry him!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu thông tin là đúng nhưng có thể làm mọi người ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you strongly believe what you are saying

examples.x: You haven't heard the last of this, believe you me!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn tin chắc vào những gì bạn đang nói

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that something is definitely not true

examples.x: ‘She wouldn’t do a thing like that.’ ‘Don’t you believe it!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói với ai đó rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn không đúng

senses.definition: to make somebody believe/understand something

examples.x: I was given to understand that she had resigned.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó tin/hiểu điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that you are surprised or annoyed about something

examples.x: I don't believe it! What are you doing here?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn ngạc nhiên hoặc khó chịu về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that you think somebody is stupid if they believe that something is true

examples.x: ‘He promised not to do it again.’ ‘Sure, and if you believe that, you’ll believe anything.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói với ai đó rằng bạn nghĩ họ ngớ ngẩn nếu họ tin rằng điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to pretend that something is true
senses.definition_vi: giả vờ rằng điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to be very surprised at something you hear/see

examples.x: I couldn't believe my eyes when she walked in.

senses.definition_vi: rất ngạc nhiên về điều gì đó bạn nghe/thấy

senses.definition: used to say that somebody will have to believe that something is true when they see it, although they do not think it is true now
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng ai đó sẽ phải tin rằng điều gì đó là đúng khi họ nhìn thấy nó, mặc dù họ không nghĩ vậy bây giờ

senses.definition: used to show that you are surprised and annoyed about something

examples.x: And, would you believe, they didn't even apologize!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn ngạc nhiên và khó chịu về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that something is definitely true

examples.x: ‘He’s not a bad player, is he?’ ‘You’d better believe it!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói với ai đó rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn là đúng

senses.definition: a hollow metal object, often like a cup in shape, that makes a ringing sound when hit by a small piece of metal inside it; the sound that it makes

examples.x: A peal of church bells rang out in the distance.
a bicycle bell
His voice came down the line as clear as a bell.
the bell of a trumpet (= the part at the end like a bell in shape)
The church bells rang out.
a bell-shaped flower
Off in the distance a bell tolled two in the morning.
a bell tower
wedding bells
The dancers wore bells on their ankles.

senses.definition_vi: một vật kim loại rỗng, thường có hình dạng giống cái cốc, phát ra âm thanh leng keng khi bị va đập bởi một mảnh kim loại nhỏ bên trong nó; âm thanh mà nó tạo ra

senses.definition: an electrical device which makes a ringing sound when a button on it is pushed; the sound that it makes, used as a signal or a warning

examples.x: Ring the bell to see if they're in.
The bell's ringing!
The bell went for the end of the lesson.
An alarm bell went off.
Warning bells started ringing in her head as she sensed that something was wrong.
This decision is going to sound a warning bell to other couples.
Saved by the bell! (= a bell that signals the end of something) I thought I'd have to sit here listening to you two argue forever.

senses.definition_vi: một thiết bị điện phát ra âm thanh leng keng khi một nút trên đó được nhấn; âm thanh mà nó tạo ra, được sử dụng làm tín hiệu hoặc cảnh báo

senses.definition: if you say that alarm bells are ringing, you mean that people are starting to feel worried and to suspect that something is wrong

examples.x: The government’s proposal has set alarm bells ringing for people on low incomes.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói rằng chuông báo động đang reo, bạn có nghĩa là mọi người đang bắt đầu cảm thấy lo lắng và nghi ngờ có điều gì đó không ổn

senses.definition: to call somebody by phone
senses.definition_vi: gọi cho ai đó bằng điện thoại

senses.definition: used to show that you do not believe what somebody has just said
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn không tin những gì ai đó vừa nói

senses.definition: to sound familiar to you, as though you have heard it before

examples.x: His name rings a bell but I can't think where we met.

senses.definition_vi: nghe quen thuộc với bạn, như thể bạn đã từng nghe thấy nó trước đây

senses.definition: in perfect condition

examples.x: The doctor said I was as sound as a bell.

senses.definition_vi: trong tình trạng hoàn hảo

senses.definition: to be in the right or suitable place

examples.x: Where do these plates belong (= where are they kept)?
Are you sure these documents belong together?
Several of the points you raise do not belong in this discussion.
A person like that does not belong in teaching.

senses.definition_vi: ở đúng hoặc phù hợp vị trí

senses.definition: to feel comfortable and happy in a particular situation or with a particular group of people

examples.x: I don't feel as if I belong here.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy thoải mái và hạnh phúc trong một tình huống cụ thể hoặc với một nhóm người cụ thể

senses.definition: loved very much

examples.x: in memory of our dearly beloved son, John
They were glad to be back in their beloved Ireland.

senses.definition_vi: được yêu rất nhiều

senses.definition: loved very much by somebody; very popular with somebody

examples.x: the deep purple flowers so beloved by artists
She was beloved by all who knew her.
The question, ‘What is History?’, beloved of university examiners, has no definitive answer.

senses.definition_vi: được ai đó yêu rất nhiều; rất phổ biến với ai đó

senses.definition: at or to a lower level, position or place

examples.x: They live on the floor below.
I could still see the airport buildings far below.
See below (= at the bottom of the page) for references.
The passengers who felt seasick stayed below (= on a lower deck).

senses.definition_vi: ở hoặc đến một mức độ, vị trí hoặc nơi thấp hơn

senses.definition: at a lower rank

examples.x: This ruling applies to the ranks of Inspector and below.

senses.definition_vi: ở cấp bậc thấp hơn

senses.definition: lower than zero

examples.x: The thermometer had dropped to a record 40 below (= −40 degrees).

senses.definition_vi: thấp hơn không

senses.definition: at or to a lower level or position than somebody/something

examples.x: He dived below the surface of the water.
Please do not write below this line.
Skirts will be worn below (= long enough to cover) the knee.

senses.definition_vi: ở hoặc đến một mức độ hoặc vị trí thấp hơn so với ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: of a lower amount or standard than somebody/something

examples.x: The temperatures remained below freezing all day.
Her work was well below average for the class.

senses.definition_vi: có số lượng hoặc tiêu chuẩn thấp hơn ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: of a lower rank or of less importance than somebody/something

examples.x: A police sergeant is below an inspector.

senses.definition_vi: có cấp bậc thấp hơn hoặc kém quan trọng hơn ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: a long narrow piece of leather, cloth, etc. that you wear around the middle part of your body

examples.x: to do up/fasten/tighten a belt
a belt buckle
a studded leather belt
Around his waist he wore a belt.

senses.definition_vi: một dải dài hẹp bằng da, vải, v.v. mà bạn đeo quanh phần giữa cơ thể

senses.definition: a continuous band of material that moves round and is used to carry things along or to drive a machine
senses.definition_vi: một dải vật liệu liên tục di chuyển vòng quanh và được sử dụng để mang vật hoặc để truyền động cho máy móc

senses.definition: a narrow area or an area around the edge of something that has particular characteristics

examples.x: the country’s corn/industrial belt
We live in the commuter belt.
a narrow belt of trees
a belt of rain moving across the country
Towns in the country's industrial belt were particularly affected by the recession.

senses.definition_vi: một khu vực hẹp hoặc một khu vực xung quanh rìa của một cái gì đó có các đặc điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: an act of hitting something/somebody hard

examples.x: She gave the ball a terrific belt.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động đánh ai đó/cái gì đó mạnh

senses.definition: unfair or cruel

examples.x: That was distinctly below the belt!

senses.definition_vi: không công bằng hoặc tàn nhẫn

senses.definition: taking more actions than are really necessary to make sure that something succeeds or works as it should

examples.x: a belt-and-braces policy

senses.definition_vi: thực hiện nhiều hành động hơn mức cần thiết để đảm bảo điều gì đó thành công hoặc hoạt động như mong đợi

senses.definition: to have already achieved or obtained something

examples.x: She already has a couple of good wins under her belt.

senses.definition_vi: đã đạt được hoặc có được điều gì đó

senses.definition: to spend less money because there is less available

examples.x: With price increases on most goods, everyone is having to tighten their belt.
There is a need for further belt-tightening.

senses.definition_vi: chi tiêu ít tiền hơn vì có ít tiền hơn sẵn có

senses.definition: a long seat for two or more people, usually made of wood

examples.x: a park bench

senses.definition_vi: một chiếc ghế dài cho hai người trở lên, thường làm bằng gỗ

senses.definition: a judge in court or the seat where he/she sits; the position of being a judge or magistrate

examples.x: His lawyer turned to address the bench.
She has recently been appointed to the bench.

senses.definition_vi: một thẩm phán tại tòa án hoặc chỗ ngồi của ông/bà ấy; vị trí thẩm phán hoặc quan tòa

senses.definition: (in the British parliament) a seat where a particular group of politicians sit

examples.x: There was cheering from the Opposition benches.

senses.definition_vi: (trong quốc hội Anh) một chỗ ngồi nơi một nhóm chính trị gia cụ thể ngồi

senses.definition: the seats where players sit when they are not playing in the game

examples.x: the substitutes’ bench
He started the game on the bench but finished as the team’s top scorer.
He's sick of spending every game on the bench.

senses.definition_vi: những chỗ ngồi mà các cầu thủ ngồi khi họ không thi đấu trong trận đấu

senses.definition: a long heavy table used for doing practical jobs, working with tools, etc.

examples.x: a carpenter’s bench

senses.definition_vi: một chiếc bàn dài, nặng dùng để làm các công việc thực tế, làm việc với công cụ, v.v.

senses.definition: something that can be measured and used as a standard that other things can be compared with

examples.x: Tests at the age of seven provide a benchmark against which the child's progress at school can be measured.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó có thể đo lường được và được sử dụng làm tiêu chuẩn để so sánh với những thứ khác

senses.definition: a curve or turn, especially in a road or river

examples.x: a sharp bend in the road
You took that bend very fast!
He lost control on a bend and crashed into a tree.
As the driver came round the bend, she saw the lorry.

senses.definition_vi: một khúc quanh hoặc chỗ rẽ, đặc biệt là trên đường hoặc sông

senses.definition: severe pain and difficulty in breathing experienced by a diver who comes back to the surface of the water too quickly
senses.definition_vi: cơn đau dữ dội và khó thở mà thợ lặn gặp phải khi quay trở lại mặt nước quá nhanh

senses.definition: crazy

examples.x: I would go round the bend if I had your job.
The kids have been driving me round the bend today (= annoying me very much).

senses.definition_vi: điên rồ

senses.definition: to lean, or make something lean, in a particular direction

examples.x: He bent and kissed her.
The doctor told me to avoid bending and stretching.
fields of poppies bending in the wind
She suddenly bent over, clutching her stomach.
She bent over him to reach her book.
He bent forward to pick up the package.
Slowly bend from the waist and bring your head down to your knees.
Keep your feet apart, and bend at the waist
He bent his head and kissed her.
She bent her head towards him.
She was bent over her desk writing a letter.

senses.definition_vi: nghiêng, hoặc làm cho cái gì đó nghiêng, theo một hướng cụ thể

senses.definition: if you bend your arm, leg, etc. or if it bends, you move it so that it is no longer straight

examples.x: Bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lie flat and let your knees bend.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn gập cánh tay, chân, v.v. của mình hoặc nếu nó bị gập lại, bạn di chuyển nó để nó không còn thẳng nữa

senses.definition: to force something that was straight into an angle or a curve

examples.x: Mark the pipe where you want to bend it.
The knives were bent out of shape.
He bent the wire into the shape of a square.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho một vật thẳng bị cong hoặc uốn cong

senses.definition: to change direction to form a curve or an angle; to make something change direction in this way

examples.x: The road bent sharply to the right.
Glass and water both bend light.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi hướng để tạo thành một đường cong hoặc một góc; làm cho một cái gì đó thay đổi hướng theo cách này

senses.definition: to talk to somebody a lot about something, especially about a problem that you have
senses.definition_vi: nói chuyện với ai đó nhiều về điều gì đó, đặc biệt là về một vấn đề mà bạn đang gặp phải

senses.definition: to think very hard about or put a lot of effort into one particular thing

examples.x: She bent her mind to the problem of escape.

senses.definition_vi: suy nghĩ rất nhiều hoặc dồn nhiều nỗ lực vào một điều gì đó cụ thể

senses.definition: to make a great effort, especially in order to be helpful or fair

examples.x: I've bent over backwards to help him.

senses.definition_vi: nỗ lực rất lớn, đặc biệt là để giúp đỡ hoặc công bằng

senses.definition: to change the rules to suit a particular person or situation

examples.x: Couldn't they just bend the rules and let us in without a ticket?

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi các quy tắc để phù hợp với một người hoặc tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: to say something that is not completely true

examples.x: I wasn’t exactly lying when I said I hadn’t seen her—I was just bending the truth a little.

senses.definition_vi: nói điều gì đó không hoàn toàn đúng sự thật

senses.definition: if you ask for something on bended knee(s), you ask for it in a very anxious and/or humble way (= showing you think you are less important than the person you are asking)

examples.x: I’d go down on bended knee if I thought she’d change her mind.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn yêu cầu điều gì đó trên đầu gối quỳ, bạn yêu cầu nó một cách rất lo lắng và/hoặc khiêm tốn (= cho thấy bạn nghĩ mình kém quan trọng hơn người bạn đang yêu cầu)

senses.definition: in or to a lower position than somebody/something; under somebody/something

examples.x: They found the body buried beneath a pile of leaves.
The boat sank beneath the waves.

senses.definition_vi: ở vị trí thấp hơn hoặc về phía thấp hơn so với ai đó/cái gì đó; dưới ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: not good enough for somebody

examples.x: He considers such jobs beneath him.
They thought she had married beneath her (= married a man of lower social status).

senses.definition_vi: không đủ tốt cho ai đó

senses.definition: improving a situation; having a helpful or useful effect

examples.x: A good diet is beneficial to health.
They finally came to a mutually beneficial agreement.

senses.definition_vi: cải thiện một tình huống; có tác dụng hữu ích hoặc có lợi

senses.definition: a person who gains as a result of something

examples.x: Who will be the main beneficiary of the cuts in income tax?

senses.definition_vi: một người được hưởng lợi từ điều gì đó

senses.definition: a person who receives money or property when somebody dies

examples.x: She was the sole beneficiary of her father’s will.

senses.definition_vi: một người nhận tiền hoặc tài sản khi ai đó qua đời

senses.definition: an advantage that something gives you; a helpful and useful effect that something has

examples.x: Freedom of information brings great benefits.
health/economic/tax benefits
the benefits of modern medicine
I've had the benefit of a good education.
It was good to see her finally reaping the benefits (= enjoying the results) of all her hard work.
The industry will be one of the first to enjoy the benefits of the recovery.
The company derived substantial benefit from the deal.
He couldn't see the benefit of arguing any longer.
The new regulations will be of benefit to everyone concerned.
It will be to your benefit to arrive early.
The project will have major benefits for the local community.
With the benefit of hindsight (= knowing what we have learnt since), we would do things differently.
Nobody should be sent to prison without the benefit of legal advice.
For maximum benefit, take the tablets before meals.

senses.definition_vi: một lợi thế mà điều gì đó mang lại cho bạn; một tác dụng hữu ích hoặc có lợi mà điều gì đó có

senses.definition: money provided by the government to people who need financial help because they are unemployed, ill, etc.

examples.x: You may be eligible to receive benefits.
The number of people claiming unemployment benefit fell last month.
The aim is to help people who are on benefits (= receiving benefits) to find jobs.

senses.definition_vi: tiền do chính phủ cung cấp cho những người cần giúp đỡ tài chính vì họ thất nghiệp, ốm đau, v.v.

senses.definition: an advantage that you get from a company in addition to the money that you earn

examples.x: Private health insurance is offered as part of the employees' benefits package.
These benefits will now be extended to agency workers.

senses.definition_vi: một lợi thế mà bạn nhận được từ một công ty ngoài tiền lương bạn kiếm được

senses.definition: money from an insurance company

examples.x: The insurance plan will provide substantial cash benefits to your family in case of your death.

senses.definition_vi: tiền từ một công ty bảo hiểm

senses.definition: an event such as a performance, a dinner, etc., organized in order to raise money for a particular person or charity

examples.x: a benefit match/concert
The proceeds from the benefit will go directly to the refugee camps.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện như buổi biểu diễn, bữa tối, v.v., được tổ chức để gây quỹ cho một người hoặc tổ chức từ thiện cụ thể

senses.definition: especially in order to help or be useful to somebody

examples.x: I have attached some lecture notes for the benefit of those people who were absent last week.
Don't go to any trouble for my benefit!

senses.definition_vi: đặc biệt là để giúp đỡ hoặc hữu ích cho ai đó

senses.definition: to accept that somebody has told the truth or behaved well because you cannot prove that they have not

examples.x: She may have been lying, but I felt I had to give her the benefit of the doubt.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận rằng ai đó đã nói sự thật hoặc cư xử tốt vì bạn không thể chứng minh rằng họ đã không làm vậy

senses.definition: to be useful to somebody or improve their life in some way

examples.x: We should spend the money on something that will benefit everyone.
The new tax laws will clearly benefit those on low wages.
The project will benefit the local community as a whole.

senses.definition_vi: hữu ích cho ai đó hoặc cải thiện cuộc sống của họ theo một cách nào đó

senses.definition: to be in a better position because of something

examples.x: We all benefit when our young people realize their potential.
Who exactly stands to benefit from these changes?
Most crime victims benefit greatly by talking about their experiences.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí tốt hơn vì điều gì đó

senses.definition: not straight

examples.x: a piece of bent wire
Do this exercise with your knees bent (= not with your legs straight).
The lamp post got bent in the crash.
Lock your elbows in a slightly bent position.

senses.definition_vi: không thẳng

senses.definition: not able to stand up straight, usually as a result of being old or ill

examples.x: a small bent old woman
He was bent double with laughter.

senses.definition_vi: không thể đứng thẳng, thường là do già hoặc ốm

senses.definition: dishonest
senses.definition_vi: gian lận

senses.definition: determined to do something (usually something bad)

examples.x: She seems bent on making life difficult for me.
to be bent on destruction/revenge
He's your typical supervillain, bent on world domination.

senses.definition_vi: quyết tâm làm điều gì đó (thường là điều xấu)

senses.definition: to become angry, anxious or upset

examples.x: Don't get bent out of shape about it. It was just a mistake!

senses.definition_vi: trở nên tức giận, lo lắng hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: next to or at the side of somebody/something

examples.x: He sat beside her all night.
a mill beside a stream

senses.definition_vi: sát cạnh hoặc ở bên cạnh ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: compared with somebody/something

examples.x: My painting looks childish beside yours.

senses.definition_vi: so với ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to not be important or closely related to the main thing you are talking about

examples.x: Yes, I know it was an accident, but that's beside the point.
They took my words out of context, but that’s beside the point.

senses.definition_vi: không quan trọng hoặc không liên quan chặt chẽ đến điều chính bạn đang nói đến

senses.definition: unable to control yourself because of the strength of emotion you are feeling

examples.x: He was beside himself with rage when I told him what I had done.
They were beside themselves with excitement.

senses.definition_vi: không thể kiểm soát bản thân vì cảm xúc quá mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: used for making an extra comment that adds to what you have just said

examples.x: I don't really want to go. Besides, it's too late now.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để đưa ra một nhận xét bổ sung, thêm vào những gì bạn vừa nói

senses.definition: in addition; also

examples.x: discounts on televisions, stereos and much more besides

senses.definition_vi: ngoài ra; cũng vậy

senses.definition: in addition to somebody/something; apart from somebody/something

examples.x: We have lots of things in common besides music.
Besides working as a doctor, he also writes novels in his spare time.
I've got no family besides my parents.
I’ve got plenty of other things to do besides talking to you.

senses.definition_vi: ngoài ai đó/cái gì đó; tách biệt khỏi ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: of the most excellent type or quality

examples.x: That's the best movie I've ever seen!
He wrote his best songs before he was 25.
She was one of the best tennis players of her generation.
Is that your best suit?
They've been best friends (= closest friends) since they were children.
the company’s best-ever results
We want the kids to have the best possible education.

senses.definition_vi: loại hoặc chất lượng xuất sắc nhất

senses.definition: giving most pleasure; happiest

examples.x: Those were the best years of my life.

senses.definition_vi: mang lại nhiều niềm vui nhất; hạnh phúc nhất

senses.definition: most suitable or appropriate

examples.x: What's the best way to cook steak?
Which is the best tool for this job?
The best thing to do would be to apologize.
It's best if you go now.
I'm not in the best position to advise you.
Owen judged it best to make no reply.

senses.definition_vi: thích hợp hoặc phù hợp nhất

senses.definition: most; to the greatest extent

examples.x: Which one do you like best?
Well-drained soil suits the plant best.
her best-known poem

senses.definition_vi: nhiều nhất; ở mức độ cao nhất

senses.definition: in the most excellent way; to the highest standard

examples.x: He works best in the mornings.
Britain’s best-dressed woman
The beaches are beautiful, but, best of all, there are very few tourists.

senses.definition_vi: một cách xuất sắc nhất; đạt tiêu chuẩn cao nhất

senses.definition: in the most suitable or appropriate way

examples.x: Painting is best done in daylight.
Do as you think best (= what you think is the most suitable thing to do).

senses.definition_vi: một cách phù hợp hoặc thích hợp nhất

senses.definition: not perfectly but as well as you are able

examples.x: We'll manage as best we can.

senses.definition_vi: không hoàn hảo nhưng tốt nhất có thể

senses.definition: to be famous or known for a particular thing that you have done in the past

examples.x: He is best remembered as the man who brought jazz to England.
She is best remembered for her first book, ‘In the Ditch’.

senses.definition_vi: nổi tiếng hoặc được biết đến vì một điều cụ thể đã làm trong quá khứ

senses.definition: the most excellent thing or person

examples.x: We all want the best for our children.
They only buy the best.
They're all good players, but she's the best of all.
We're the best of friends (= very close friends).

senses.definition_vi: điều hoặc người xuất sắc nhất

senses.definition: the highest standard that somebody/something can reach

examples.x: She always brings out the best in people.
The town looks its best (= is most attractive) in the spring.
Don't worry about the exam—just do your best.
The roses are past their best now.
I don't really feel at my best today.

senses.definition_vi: tiêu chuẩn cao nhất mà ai đó/cái gì đó có thể đạt được

senses.definition: something that is as close as possible to what you need or want

examples.x: Fifty pounds is the best I can offer you.
The best we can hope for in the game is a draw.

senses.definition_vi: điều gần nhất có thể với những gì bạn cần hoặc muốn

senses.definition: the highest standard that a particular person has reached, especially in a sport

examples.x: a lifetime best of 12.0 seconds

senses.definition_vi: tiêu chuẩn cao nhất mà một người cụ thể đạt được, đặc biệt là trong thể thao

senses.definition: used when you are saying goodbye to somebody or ending a letter, to give somebody your good wishes
senses.definition_vi: dùng khi tạm biệt ai đó hoặc kết thúc thư, để gửi lời chúc tốt đẹp đến ai đó

senses.definition: used for saying what is the best opinion you can have of somebody/something, or the best thing that can happen, when the situation is bad

examples.x: Their response to the proposal was, at best, cool.
We can't arrive before Friday at best.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói về ý kiến tốt nhất bạn có thể có về ai đó/cái gì đó, hoặc điều tốt nhất có thể xảy ra, khi tình hình tồi tệ

senses.definition: used to say that although something appears bad or unpleasant now, it will be good in the end

examples.x: I don't want you to leave, but perhaps it's for the best.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng mặc dù điều gì đó có vẻ tồi tệ hoặc khó chịu bây giờ, nhưng cuối cùng nó sẽ tốt đẹp

senses.definition: a person or thing that is a little better than the rest of a group, although none are very good
senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật tốt hơn một chút so với phần còn lại của nhóm, mặc dù không ai thực sự tốt

senses.definition: the best out of a group of people or things
senses.definition_vi: tốt nhất trong một nhóm người hoặc vật

senses.definition: used to wish somebody success with something

examples.x: The best of luck with your exams.
Good luck! I hope it goes well.
‘I'm going to try giving up social media for a year.’ ‘Good luck with that (= I don't think you will succeed).’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để chúc ai đó thành công với điều gì đó

senses.definition: up to three, five, etc. games played to decide who wins, the winner being the person who wins most of them
senses.definition_vi: tối đa ba, năm, v.v. trận đấu được chơi để quyết định ai thắng, người thắng là người thắng nhiều nhất trong số đó

senses.definition: the very best

examples.x: We make sure our clients get the best that money can buy.

senses.definition_vi: tuyệt vời nhất

senses.definition: to do or say something in order to achieve a good result or to help somebody

examples.x: I just don't know what to do for the best.
I'm sorry if my advice offended you—I meant it for the best.

senses.definition_vi: làm hoặc nói điều gì đó để đạt được kết quả tốt hoặc giúp đỡ ai đó

senses.definition: to gain more advantage from something than somebody else

examples.x: I thought you had the best of that discussion.

senses.definition_vi: thu được nhiều lợi ích nhất từ điều gì đó hơn người khác

senses.definition: to hope that something will happen successfully, especially where it seems likely that it will not

examples.x: I’m just going to answer all the questions I can and hope for the best.

senses.definition_vi: hy vọng điều gì đó sẽ thành công, đặc biệt là khi có vẻ như không thể

senses.definition: to accept a bad or difficult situation and do as well as you can
senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận một tình huống tồi tệ hoặc khó khăn và cố gắng hết sức

senses.definition: your best clothes

examples.x: I put on my Sunday best for the occasion.

senses.definition_vi: quần áo đẹp nhất của bạn

senses.definition: as far as you know

examples.x: He never made a will, to the best of my knowledge.

senses.definition_vi: trong phạm vi bạn biết

senses.definition: as well as anyone

examples.x: He'll be out there, dancing with the best of them.

senses.definition_vi: giỏi như bất kỳ ai

senses.definition: an arrangement to risk money, etc. on the result of a particular event; the money that you risk in this way

examples.x: to win/lose a bet
I was tempted to place a large bet.
We've got a bet on who's going to arrive first.
He had a bet on the horses.
They all put a bet on the race.
I hear you're taking bets on whether she'll marry him.
I did it for a bet (= because somebody had agreed to pay me money if I did).
‘Liverpool are bound to win.’ ‘Do you want a bet?’ (= I disagree with you, I don't think they will.)

senses.definition_vi: một thỏa thuận để đặt cược tiền, v.v. vào kết quả của một sự kiện cụ thể; số tiền bạn đặt cược theo cách này

senses.definition: an opinion about what is likely to happen or to have happened

examples.x: My bet is that they've been held up in traffic.

senses.definition_vi: một ý kiến về những gì có khả năng xảy ra hoặc đã xảy ra

senses.definition: used to say that if a particular event happens then your current prediction, agreement, etc. will no longer apply

examples.x: We expect shares to rise unless the economy slows down again, in which case all bets are off.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng nếu sự kiện cụ thể xảy ra thì dự đoán, thỏa thuận hiện tại của bạn sẽ không còn hiệu lực

senses.definition: used to tell somebody what is the best action for them to take to get the result they want

examples.x: If you want to get around London fast, the Underground is your best bet.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói với ai đó hành động tốt nhất cho họ để đạt được kết quả mong muốn

senses.definition: something that is likely to happen, to succeed or to be suitable

examples.x: He's a good bet to earn a spot on the US team.
Clothes are a safe bet as a present for a teenager.
The movie looks like a sure bet for Best Film.

senses.definition_vi: điều gì đó có khả năng xảy ra, thành công hoặc phù hợp

senses.definition: to reduce the risk of losing or making a mistake by supporting more than one side in a competition, an argument, etc., or by having several choices available to you

examples.x: She hedged her bets by applying for various other jobs as well.

senses.definition_vi: giảm thiểu rủi ro thua lỗ hoặc mắc sai lầm bằng cách ủng hộ nhiều hơn một bên trong cuộc thi, tranh luận, v.v., hoặc bằng cách có nhiều lựa chọn có sẵn cho bạn

senses.definition: to risk money on a race or an event by trying to predict the result

examples.x: You have to be over 16 to bet.
I wouldn't bet on them winning the next election.
Not many people are betting against France retaining their title.
He likes betting on horses and watching table tennis.
He bet $2 000 on the final score of the game.
You shouldn't praise a gambler for betting his life savings if he wins.
She bet me £20 (that) I wouldn't do it.
I bet her (that) the Democrats would not win.
He bet ten dollars (that) he could write a complete story in just six words.

senses.definition_vi: đặt cược tiền vào một cuộc đua hoặc một sự kiện bằng cách cố gắng dự đoán kết quả

senses.definition: used to say that you are almost certain that something is true or that something will happen

examples.x: I bet (that) we’re too late.
You can bet (that) the moment I sit down, the baby will wake up.
I'm willing to bet (that) the analysts will be wrong.
I’ll bet you (that) he knows all about it.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn gần như chắc chắn rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: to risk everything you have on an investment, a bet, etc.

examples.x: The company bet the farm on the new marketing model, only to find that it wasn’t successful.

senses.definition_vi: đặt cược tất cả những gì bạn có vào một khoản đầu tư, một vụ cá cược, v.v.

senses.definition: used to show that you can understand what somebody is feeling, describing, etc.

examples.x: ‘I nearly died when he told me.’ ‘I bet!’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn có thể hiểu những gì ai đó đang cảm thấy, mô tả, v.v.

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that you do not believe what they have just said

examples.x: ‘I'm going to tell her what I think of her.’ ‘Yeah, I bet!’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói với ai đó rằng bạn không tin những gì họ vừa nói

senses.definition: used to say that you do not think that something is very likely

examples.x: ‘She'll soon get used to the idea.’ ‘I wouldn't bet on it.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn không nghĩ điều gì đó có khả năng xảy ra

senses.definition: used instead of ‘yes’ to emphasize that somebody has guessed something correctly or made a good suggestion

examples.x: ‘Are you nervous?’ ‘You bet!’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng thay cho 'yes' để nhấn mạnh rằng ai đó đã đoán đúng điều gì đó hoặc đưa ra một gợi ý hay

senses.definition: used to say that you are certain that something will happen

examples.x: You can bet your bottom dollar that he'll be late.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn chắc chắn điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: to give information about somebody/something to an enemy

examples.x: He was offered money to betray his colleagues.
For years they had been betraying state secrets to Russia.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp thông tin về ai đó/điều gì đó cho kẻ thù

senses.definition: to hurt somebody who trusts you, especially by lying to or about them or telling their secrets to other people

examples.x: She felt betrayed when she found out the truth about him.
She betrayed his trust over and over again.
I have never known her to betray a confidence (= tell other people something that should be kept secret).

senses.definition_vi: làm tổn thương người tin tưởng bạn, đặc biệt bằng cách nói dối về họ hoặc tiết lộ bí mật của họ cho người khác

senses.definition: to ignore your principles or beliefs in order to achieve something or gain an advantage for yourself

examples.x: He has been accused of betraying his former socialist ideals.

senses.definition_vi: phớt lờ các nguyên tắc hoặc niềm tin của bạn để đạt được điều gì đó hoặc giành lợi thế cho bản thân

senses.definition: to tell somebody or make them aware of a piece of information, a feeling, etc., usually without meaning to

examples.x: His voice betrayed the worry he was trying to hide.
She was terrified of saying something that would make her betray herself (= show her feelings or who she was).

senses.definition_vi: tiết lộ cho ai đó hoặc làm cho họ nhận thức được một mẩu thông tin, một cảm xúc, v.v., thường là vô tình

senses.definition: of a higher standard or less poor quality; not as bad as something else

examples.x: We're hoping for better weather tomorrow.
Her work is getting better and better.
He is in a much better mood than usual.
The meal couldn't have been better.
There's nothing better than a long soak in a hot bath.
If you can only exercise once a week, that's better than nothing (= better than taking no exercise at all).

senses.definition_vi: có tiêu chuẩn cao hơn hoặc chất lượng kém hơn; không tệ như cái khác

senses.definition: more suitable or appropriate

examples.x: Can you think of a better word than ‘nice’?
It would be better for him to talk to his parents about his problems.
You'd be better going by bus.

senses.definition_vi: thích hợp hoặc phù hợp hơn

senses.definition: more able; showing more skill

examples.x: She's far better at science than her brother.

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng hơn; thể hiện kỹ năng tốt hơn

senses.definition: less ill or unhappy

examples.x: She's a lot better today.
His leg was getting better.
You'll feel all the better for a good night's sleep.

senses.definition_vi: ít ốm yếu hoặc bất hạnh hơn

senses.definition: fully recovered after an illness; in good health again

examples.x: Don't go back to work until you are better.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn hồi phục sau khi bị bệnh; khỏe mạnh trở lại

senses.definition: most of something, especially a period of time; more than half of something

examples.x: He drank the best part of a bottle of Scotch waiting for her to get home.
The journey took her the better part of an hour.

senses.definition_vi: hầu hết mọi thứ, đặc biệt là một khoảng thời gian; hơn một nửa của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that something should be as big, small, etc. as possible

examples.x: I love giving parties, the bigger the better.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng một cái gì đó nên lớn nhất, nhỏ nhất, v.v., có thể

senses.definition: you should avoid danger and not take unnecessary risks
senses.definition_vi: bạn nên tránh nguy hiểm và không chấp nhận rủi ro không cần thiết

senses.definition: almost or just the same as; almost or just as bad as

examples.x: The path was no better than a sheep track.
Charles VII was a bad king and Charles VIII was no better.

senses.definition_vi: gần như hoặc tương đương với; gần như hoặc tệ như

senses.definition: it is better to stop something bad from happening rather than try to deal with the problems after it has happened

examples.x: Prevention is better than cure, so start looking after your heart now.
Prevention is better than cure, so start taking care of yourself.

senses.definition_vi: tốt hơn là ngăn chặn điều gì đó tồi tệ xảy ra thay vì cố gắng giải quyết các vấn đề sau khi nó đã xảy ra

senses.definition: used to give support to somebody who has been upset and is trying to become calmer

examples.x: Dry your eyes now. That's better.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để hỗ trợ ai đó đã buồn và đang cố gắng bình tĩnh hơn

senses.definition: used to praise somebody who has made an effort to improve

examples.x: That's much better—you played the right notes this time.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để khen ngợi ai đó đã nỗ lực để cải thiện

senses.definition: used to say that two people can achieve more than one person working alone
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng hai người có thể đạt được nhiều hơn một người làm việc một mình

senses.definition: in a more excellent or pleasant way; not as badly

examples.x: She sings much better than I do.
Sound travels better in water than in air.
People are better educated now.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách xuất sắc hoặc dễ chịu hơn; không tệ như vậy

senses.definition: more; to a greater degree

examples.x: You'll like her when you know her better.
A cup of tea? There's nothing I'd like better!
Fit people are better able to cope with stress.
Researchers are hoping to better understand the role of this protein in human disease.

senses.definition_vi: nhiều hơn; ở mức độ cao hơn

senses.definition: used to suggest that something would be a suitable or appropriate thing to do

examples.x: The money could be better spent on more urgent cases.
Some things are better left unsaid.
You'd do better to tell her everything before she finds out from someone else.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng một cái gì đó sẽ là một điều phù hợp hoặc thích hợp để làm

senses.definition: to have more money

examples.x: Families will be better off under the new law.
Her promotion means she's $100 a week better off.

senses.definition_vi: có nhiều tiền hơn

senses.definition: used to say that somebody is/would be happier or more satisfied because they are/if they were in a particular position or doing a particular thing

examples.x: She's better off without him.
The weather was so bad we'd have been better off staying at home.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng ai đó sẽ hạnh phúc hơn hoặc hài lòng hơn vì họ đang ở/nếu họ ở một vị trí cụ thể hoặc làm một việc cụ thể

senses.definition: used to say that while one thing is good, another thing is even better

examples.x: You can see and, better yet, hear the effects of these changes on their website.
I wanted to make my parents proud by becoming a lawyer or, better yet, a doctor.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng trong khi một điều gì đó tốt, thì một điều khác còn tốt hơn

senses.definition: used to tell somebody what you think they should do

examples.x: You'd better go to the doctor about your cough.
We'd better leave now or we'll miss the bus.
You'd better not do that again.
‘I'll give you back the money tomorrow.’ ‘You'd better!’ (= as a threat)
If you think it is going to be easy, you'd best think again.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói với ai đó những gì bạn nghĩ họ nên làm

senses.definition: something that is better

examples.x: the better of the two books
I expected better of him (= I thought he would have behaved better).

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó tốt hơn

senses.definition: people who are more intelligent or more important than you
senses.definition_vi: những người thông minh hơn hoặc quan trọng hơn bạn

senses.definition: a person, thing, situation, etc. that is better/worse than the previous or present one

examples.x: Voters see the new leader as a change for the better.
I reckon we've all made a big change for the better.
His family had detected a change for the worse in his behaviour.

senses.definition_vi: một người, vật, tình huống, v.v., tốt hơn/tệ hơn cái trước đó hoặc cái hiện tại

senses.definition: people who are older and wiser than you and that you should respect
senses.definition_vi: những người lớn tuổi hơn, khôn ngoan hơn bạn và bạn nên tôn trọng

senses.definition: used to say that something cannot be changed, whether the result is good or bad
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng một cái gì đó không thể thay đổi, dù kết quả tốt hay xấu

senses.definition: to defeat somebody/something or gain an advantage

examples.x: No one can get the better of her in an argument.
She always gets the better of an argument.
His curiosity got the better of him (= he didn't intend to ask questions, but he wanted to know so badly that he did).

senses.definition_vi: đánh bại ai đó/cái gì đó hoặc giành được lợi thế

senses.definition: used to say that something is even better/worse

examples.x: We don't actually need it on Tuesday, but if it arrives by then, so much the better.
If hurricanes become more powerful, as current research suggests, so much the worse.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng một điều gì đó còn tốt hơn/tệ hơn

senses.definition: to have a higher opinion of somebody

examples.x: She has behaved appallingly—I must say I thought better of her.

senses.definition_vi: có ý kiến cao hơn về ai đó

senses.definition: in the space or period of time separating two or more points, objects, etc. or two dates, events, etc.

examples.x: The house was near a park but there was a road in between.
I see her most weekends but not very often in between.

senses.definition_vi: trong không gian hoặc khoảng thời gian ngăn cách hai hoặc nhiều điểm, vật thể, v.v. hoặc hai ngày, sự kiện, v.v.

senses.definition: in a middle position; neither one thing nor the other

examples.x: He found himself placed betwixt and between in the debate, agreeing with parts of each side’s arguments.

senses.definition_vi: ở vị trí giữa; không hẳn cái này cũng không hẳn cái kia

senses.definition: in or into the space separating two or more points, objects, people, etc.

examples.x: Q comes between P and R in the English alphabet.
I sat down between Jo and Diana.
Switzerland lies between France, Germany, Austria and Italy.
The paper had fallen down between the desk and the wall.
My job is somewhere between a secretary and a personal assistant.

senses.definition_vi: trong hoặc vào không gian ngăn cách hai hoặc nhiều điểm, vật thể, người, v.v.

senses.definition: in the period of time that separates two days, years, events, etc.

examples.x: It's cheaper between 6 p.m. and 8 a.m.
Don't eat between meals.
Children must attend school between the ages of 5 and 16.
Many changes took place between the two world wars.

senses.definition_vi: trong khoảng thời gian ngăn cách hai ngày, năm, sự kiện, v.v.

senses.definition: at some point along a scale from one amount, weight, distance, etc. to another

examples.x: It weighed between nine and ten kilos.
The temperature remained between 25°C and 30°C all week.

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm nào đó dọc theo thang đo từ một lượng, trọng lượng, khoảng cách, v.v. đến một lượng khác

senses.definition: separating one place from another

examples.x: the border between Sweden and Norway

senses.definition_vi: ngăn cách nơi này với nơi khác

senses.definition: from one place to another

examples.x: We fly between Rome and Paris twice daily.

senses.definition_vi: từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: used to show a connection or relationship

examples.x: a difference/distinction/contrast between two things
a link between unemployment and crime
There's a lot of bad feeling between them.
I had to choose between the two jobs.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để chỉ ra một sự kết nối hoặc mối quan hệ

senses.definition: shared by two or more people or things

examples.x: We ate a pizza between us.
This is just between you and me/between ourselves (= it is a secret).

senses.definition_vi: được chia sẻ bởi hai hoặc nhiều người hoặc vật

senses.definition: by putting together the efforts or actions of two or more people or groups

examples.x: We ought to be able to manage it between us.
China and India between them account for a third of the world's population.

senses.definition_vi: bằng cách kết hợp nỗ lực hoặc hành động của hai hoặc nhiều người hoặc nhóm

senses.definition: used to show that several activities are involved

examples.x: Between working full-time and taking care of the kids, he didn't have much time for hobbies.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để chỉ ra rằng có nhiều hoạt động liên quan

senses.definition: on the other side; further on

examples.x: Snowdon and the mountains beyond were covered in snow.
The immediate future is clear, but it's hard to tell what lies beyond.
the year 2025 and beyond

senses.definition_vi: ở phía bên kia; xa hơn nữa

senses.definition: (to do) even more than is expected or demanded

examples.x: Our staff members will go above and beyond to ensure that our customers are satisfied.

senses.definition_vi: (để làm) nhiều hơn cả mong đợi hoặc yêu cầu

senses.definition: a place that is a long way from other houses, towns, etc.

examples.x: We stayed in some farmhouse in the back of beyond.

senses.definition_vi: một nơi cách xa các ngôi nhà, thị trấn khác, v.v.

senses.definition: used when you are giving your opinion and emphasizing the point that you are making

examples.x: This meeting has been, without doubt, one of the most useful we have had so far.
Without the slightest doubt this is a remarkable exhibition.
She is without a doubt the best player I know.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng khi bạn đưa ra ý kiến của mình và nhấn mạnh điểm bạn đang nói

senses.definition: on or to the further side of something

examples.x: The road continues beyond the village up into the hills.

senses.definition_vi: ở hoặc về phía xa hơn của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: more than something

examples.x: Our success was far beyond what we thought possible.
She's got nothing beyond her state pension.

senses.definition_vi: nhiều hơn một cái gì đó

senses.definition: later than a particular time

examples.x: It won't go on beyond midnight.
I know what I'll be doing for the next three weeks but I haven't thought beyond that.

senses.definition_vi: muộn hơn một thời điểm nhất định

senses.definition: used to say that something is not possible

examples.x: The bicycle was beyond repair (= is too badly damaged to repair).
The situation is beyond our control.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng một điều gì đó là không thể

senses.definition: too far or too advanced for somebody/something

examples.x: The handle was just beyond my reach.
The exercise was beyond the abilities of most of the class.

senses.definition_vi: quá xa hoặc quá tiến bộ đối với ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to be impossible for somebody to imagine, understand or do

examples.x: It's beyond me why she wants to marry Jeff.

senses.definition_vi: không thể cho ai đó tưởng tượng, hiểu hoặc làm được

senses.definition: a strong feeling in favour of or against one group of people, or one side in an argument, often not based on fair judgement

examples.x: accusations of political bias in news programmes (= that reports are unfair and show favour to one political party)
Employers must consider all candidates impartially and without bias.
Do you think that there's still a bias against women in some industries?
The article examines gender bias in our schools.

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác mạnh mẽ ủng hộ hoặc chống lại một nhóm người, hoặc một bên trong một cuộc tranh cãi, thường không dựa trên sự phán xét công bằng

senses.definition: an interest in one thing more than others; a special ability

examples.x: The course has a strong practical bias.
Leila had a marked scientific bias.
In some British universities there was a bias towards pure science.

senses.definition_vi: sự quan tâm đến một điều gì đó hơn những điều khác; một khả năng đặc biệt

senses.definition: the fact that the results of research or an experiment are not accurate because a particular factor has not been considered when collecting the information

examples.x: If a response rate is low, the risk of bias in the findings will be greater.

senses.definition_vi: việc kết quả nghiên cứu hoặc thí nghiệm không chính xác vì một yếu tố nào đó đã không được xem xét khi thu thập thông tin

senses.definition: the bias of a piece of cloth is an edge cut diagonally across the threads

examples.x: The skirt is cut on the bias.
a bias strip

senses.definition_vi: cạnh xéo của một miếng vải là một cạnh được cắt chéo theo đường sợi vải

senses.definition: a road vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing the pedals with your feet

examples.x: He got on his bicycle and rode off.
We went for a bicycle ride on Sunday.
She spent the day riding her bicycle around the lake.
a bicycle helmet/wheel

senses.definition_vi: một phương tiện giao thông trên đường có hai bánh mà bạn lái bằng cách đạp bàn đạp bằng chân

senses.definition: an offer by a person or a company to pay a particular amount of money for something

examples.x: A German firm launched a takeover bid for the company.
At the auction (= a public sale where things are sold to the person who offers the most), the highest bid for the picture was £200.
the highest bid on the picture
Any more bids?

senses.definition_vi: một lời đề nghị của một người hoặc một công ty để trả một số tiền nhất định cho một thứ gì đó

senses.definition: an offer to do work or provide a service for a particular price, in competition with other companies, etc.

examples.x: The company submitted a bid for the contract to clean the hospital.

senses.definition_vi: một lời đề nghị làm việc hoặc cung cấp dịch vụ với một mức giá nhất định, cạnh tranh với các công ty khác, v.v.

senses.definition: an effort to do something or to obtain something

examples.x: a bid for power
a desperate bid to escape from his attackers
